chu_de: CHI THI #10: bo_set + .ex5 (CLMCA, CCBSN), bo sung #9
noi_dung:
CHI THI #10 (bo sung cho #9, khong thay #9; tra loi y f39f): DA CO `bo_set` + chay `.ex5` hop den. `git pull` TRUOC; doc tai_lieu/LAN_EA_THO.md muc bo_set / .ex5.

A. Cach goi (may nha, MOT terminal tester, Model=4):
 `b nc cc ea_tho_chay '{"ea":"<duong .ex5 hoac .mq5>","ma":"XAUUSD","khung":"M15","doan":"kham_pha","bo_set":"<duong .set>","gt_id":N}'`
 - `bo_set` = DUONG toi .set cua tac gia, chay nguyen van; khong dung chung `tham_so`. .set co dong giong khoa / mat khau -> TU CHOI (repo public): xoa gia tri do = bo KHAC, ghi ro.
 - `tham_so` sai ten / khong phai so nay bi TU CHOI (truoc day MT5 im lang bo qua).
 - `.ex5`: chi chay khi terminal TAT "Allow DLL imports" (bat = tu choi), chi tester / DEMO, ban chep bi xoa sau khi chay. `.ex4` (MT4) khong chay duoc: bo qua. KHONG commit bot / .set co khoa.
 - Von tester co dinh 10.000: voi bo .set viet cho von khac thi lai / DD % khac loi tac gia - doc them DD bang tien va lot.

B. Thu tu (tester la nut that; may TON DIEN: xong thi bao chu du an tat may):
 1. #9 muc B1 giu nguyen va LAM DAU: `ea_LuoiThamChieu.mq5` + `tick_tu` + chi phi XM that (day la lan `_chay_that` dau - neu hong o day thi dung, bao ve).
 2. CLMCA (.mq5 + 5 .set, du_lieu_cao/telegram/vutruea/CLMCA; XAUUSD M15): `ea_tho_kham` -> `ea_tho_chay` mac dinh -> 5 .set bang `bo_set`, TAT CA duoi MOT gt_id (`ghi_gia_thuyet`: "CLMCA 5 chien luoc XAUUSD M15, tac gia noi PF 1,24-1,36, chua kiem").
 3. CCBSN v3.0.5 `.ex5` (du_lieu_cao/drive_trade_an_lac): MOT lan truoc, bo "10K" (dung von 10.000), ma + khung theo ten bo; neu >= 20 lenh moi chay 9 bo con lai. Ke tiep: Gold Hunter (2 .set), Black Dragon V13 (.set vang). Moi bot MOT gt_id (ghi ten bot + "hop den, chua phai cua ta").
 4. It lenh (< 20) hoac bao cao la -> CHUA_DO_DUOC, ghi 1 dong ly do, DUNG; khong bat DLL, khong thu bien tau.

C. KHONG niem phong gi. Xong: MOT thu `XONG ...` <= 15 dong loi thuong (bot nao chay duoc / so lenh / lai sau phi / maxDD / ly do bi chan); so chi tiet vao `reports/ea_tho_<ngay>.md`. Ket qua CCBSN la DAP AN THAT de cloud doi chieu ban luoi lam lai trong luoi.py - ghi them lot lon nhat va so lenh mo toi da.
